channel.title: Ali Rezaali — Research Notes & Applied Code
channel.description: Technical notes on Earth Engine automation, reproducible geospatial workflows, and the code behind environmental and urban hazard monitoring.

item.title: Renaming Non-Empty Asset Folders in Google Earth Engine
item.description: The GEE Code Editor only allows renaming empty folders. This recursive Python script migrates every child asset into a new folder and cleans up the source — no manual dragging required.
item.author: Ali Rezaali

item.title: Batch Deleting Google Earth Engine Assets
item.description: The GEE Code Editor can only delete one asset at a time. This script reconstructs a target set from a naming pattern and removes every match in a single pass.
item.author: Ali Rezaali

item.title: Unlocking a Frozen Google Earth Engine Repository
item.description: When the GEE Code Editor stops saving and greys out every action button, the fix isn't in the browser. Force a server-side re-index from the Git CLI.
item.author: Ali Rezaali

item.title: Auto-Expanding JSON Logs in the Google Earth Engine Console
item.description: A quick browser snippet to auto-click every JSON expander in the GEE console without freezing the UI.
item.author: Ali Rezaali
